About this item

  • Efficient Intel N150 Processor - Powered by Intel N150 quad-core processor with max turbo speeds up to 3.6GHz and 6MB Intel Smart Cache, this laptop delivers smooth performance for everyday computing tasks including web browsing, document editing, video streaming, and light multitasking. Integrated Intel Graphics handles casual entertainment and productivity applications with ease, making it perfect for students, home users, and professionals on the go.
  • 8GB LPDDR5 RAM & 128GB UFS 2.2 Storage - Equipped with 8GB soldered LPDDR5-4800 memory for responsive multitasking and fast application loading, paired with 128GB UFS 2.2 storage providing quick boot times and file access. The efficient memory architecture ensures smooth performance across multiple browser tabs, office applications, and everyday software. Expandable storage available via SD card reader for additional photos, documents, and media files.
  • 15.6" FHD Display with Immersive Viewing - Features a 15.6-inch Full HD (1920x1080) anti-glare display with 250 nits brightness and 88% screen-to-body ratio, delivering clear visuals for work and entertainment. The TN panel reduces eye strain during extended use, while the slim bezels maximize your viewing area. HD 720p camera with privacy shutter enables secure video conferencing, and user-facing stereo speakers (1.5W x2) with HD audio provide clear sound for calls and media.
  • Modern Connectivity & AI Copilot Integration - Stay connected with WiFi 6 (802.11ax) and Bluetooth 5.2 for fast wireless performance. Versatile port selection includes 2x USB-A 5Gbps, 1x USB-C with Power Delivery and DisplayPort 1.2 support, HDMI 1.4 for external displays, headphone/mic combo jack, and SD card reader. Features dedicated AI Copilot hotkey on the English US keyboard for instant access to AI assistance, enhancing productivity and streamlining your workflow.
  • Portable Design with Windows 11 & Microsoft 365 - Ultra-portable at just 3.42 lbs (1.55 kg) and 0.70 inches thin, perfect for students, travelers, and mobile professionals. Arctic Grey finish with durable PC-ABS construction. Pre-loaded with Windows 11 Home and Microsoft 365 Personal subscription for immediate productivity. MIL-STD-810H military-grade tested for durability, ENERGY STAR 9.0 certified, and includes Firmware TPM 2.0 security. 65W power adapter ensures fast charging.

Product Description

Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 - Portable Everyday Performance

The Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 15.6-inch laptop combines reliable performance, modern connectivity, and a lightweight design. It is ideal for students, remote workers, home users, and budget-conscious buyers.

Key Features

  • Reliable Performance: The Intel N150 quad-core processor, with speeds up to 3.6GHz and 6MB cache, works with 8GB LPDDR5-4800 memory for browsing, document editing, streaming, online classes, video calls, and light multitasking.
  • Full HD Display: The 15.6-inch 1920 x 1080 anti-glare screen features 250-nit brightness and an 88% screen-to-body ratio for comfortable work and entertainment.
  • Fast Storage: The 128GB UFS 2.2 storage supports responsive startup and provides space for essential applications, documents, and media.
  • AI-Ready Productivity: A dedicated Copilot key provides quick access to supported Windows 11 AI features, while Windows 11 Home and Microsoft 365 Personal support everyday productivity.
  • Modern Connectivity: Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.2 provide reliable wireless connections. Ports include 2 USB-A 5Gbps, USB-C with Power Delivery and DisplayPort, HDMI 1.4, and an SD card reader.
  • Clear Communication: An HD 720p camera with privacy shutter, dual-array microphones, and dual 1.5W stereo speakers support meetings, classes, and entertainment.
  • Portable and Durable: Weighing 3.42 lb and measuring 0.70 inches thin, it is easy to carry. MIL-STD-810H testing across 21 items supports dependable daily use.

Additional features include integrated Intel Graphics, Firmware TPM 2.0, a 65W power adapter, and dimensions of 14.14 x 9.21 x 0.70 inches. This versatile laptop is ready for schoolwork, remote work, browsing, streaming, and email.

    Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.
